Metadata.title: VisionAttend
Metadata.description: Facial-recognition attendance for colleges, offices and factories.

TopBar.notificationsEmptyBody: Alerts about attendance, requests and tickets will appear here.

Home.title: Attendance that recognizes you
Home.subtitle: Check in with your face in seconds, from your phone or a kiosk at the entrance. Private by design: only a numeric face signature ever leaves your device.

face.title: Face check-in
face.body: Liveness-checked face recognition on your phone or a shared kiosk.

kiosk.title: Hands-free kiosk
kiosk.body: A tablet at the door recognizes people as they walk in and greets them.

voice.title: Voice guidance
voice.body: Spoken greetings and voice commands in your own language.

languages.title: Your language
languages.body: The whole app works in English and Hindi, with more languages to come.

insights.title: Live insights
insights.body: Who is in right now, late arrivals and trends at a glance.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.body: Explicit consent, encrypted face data and one-tap deletion.

DesignSystem.title: Design system
DesignSystem.subtitle: The tokens and components every VisionAttend screen is built from.
DesignSystem.typeBody: Body text is comfortable to read on a phone and on a desktop.
DesignSystem.typeMuted: Muted text for hints and secondary details.
DesignSystem.dialogBody: Dialogs trap focus, close with Escape and work with screen readers.
DesignSystem.emptyBody: When there is data to show, it appears here.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The page you were looking for does not exist or has moved.
